description.en: Gives a tactic with a chosen message. Tactics are given as items: RunGetItemEx(_tcs, 1, 30, 30, "J_07", 0, _msg). The BGM is stopped with a fade of 30, the function waits 30 frames, and the jingle J_07 plays while the message shows. No shipped script calls it directly.
Message ID to show instead of the default one.

examples.case: How RunGetTactics uses it (real code, from ie4_ev_main.nut)
